protocol: Purposive mechanistic casebook; source units are already in frozen probability sample and must not be double counted.
reviewer: source_inventory_4, AI source-first inventory then paired-raw case review
leaf_count_policy: Count exact finite source-listed local condition identities only; group effect, score weights and scopes are separately audited. Null means no defensible finite leaf denominator.
countermodel_policy: Symbolic countermodels/projection witnesses, not newly observed patient outcomes or production-engine replays. Source-ambiguous full groups remain ambiguous.

leaf_coverage.unit: alternative evidence-route leaves, not positive marker count

exact_failure.old: ANY/n=1 is broadly correct, but required_for and feature_of coexist in one group, losing its uniform necessary effect; epithelial morphology becomes an unresolved origin macro.
exact_failure.new: AT_LEAST(1) with uniform required_for improves the effect. The two epithelial-evidence routes remain compressed into epithelial origin; GATA3 method/component scope remains thin. This is not an n=1 error.

countermodels.source: ANY is true, so this necessary group cannot reject S-UC.
countermodels.old_raw: Treating required_for epithelial-origin as a separate mandatory atom can reject when its unresolved macro is not matched, even though CK evidence is present; CK is only feature_of.
countermodels.qualification: This exposes ambiguity permitted by mixed effects. A particular downstream implementation must be replayed before asserting an observed veto.

countermodels.new_raw: The group condition is unknown without a trusted resolver mapping CK/morphology to the epithelial-origin macro.
countermodels.qualification: Do not set a biologically true origin false; the divergence concerns missing typed evidence binding, not a medical counterexample to epithelial origin.

attribution.rationale: The actual input and saved raw JSON already diverge; no normalization or executor is needed to observe the loss/change.
The nested verbal OR is associatively equivalent to one ANY of three leaves; uniform member relations can carry the common effect. Flat syntax alone does not force this failure.
Prompt/schema guidance is incomplete in this dimension, but the unique contribution of prompt wording versus model generation has not been experimentally isolated.

cases.notes: Leaf coverage counts finding identity and local sign only, not complete rule effect. Macro acceptance is a separate sensitivity, not assumed compiled fidelity.

countermodels.qualification: This sibling error comes from S3-08-R08 and is cited to show how atom effects can damage a group process; it is not counted as a ninth panel source unit.

countermodels.source: The word including does not license sufficient AFX diagnosis after clearing only the three examples.
countermodels.unsafe_flat_repair: Closed ALL of three named exclusions would incorrectly mark the entire exclusion process complete.
countermodels.qualification: No unnamed competitor is invented as a specific disease; this is an open-domain logical countermodel.
